# Santa Catarina Front-Row Suite, Porto

> A 56 m2 vacation rental apartment directly on Rua de Santa Catarina, the pedestrian shopping street in central Porto, Portugal. Licensed Alojamento Local 165999/AL.

## Facts
- Address: Rua de Santa Catarina 392, 2 Frt Esq, 4000-446 Porto, Portugal
- Capacity: 2 guests, 1 double bed, 1 bathroom with walk-in shower
- Size: 56 m2, second floor with lift
- Tall acoustic windows facing the street; quiet sleeping area
- Amenities: air conditioning, Wi-Fi, dedicated workspace, TV, washer and dryer, full kitchen (oven, stove, microwave, dishwasher, espresso machine, kettle)
- Check-in from 16:00, check-out until 11:00
- Rating: 4.78 from 18 reviews on Airbnb (October 2026), Guest favourite, Superhost

## Location notes
Pedestrian street with shops and cafes. Short walk to Bolhao Market, Capela das Almas (blue tiled chapel) and Bolhao metro station.
